name: Sculpfun S40 MAX 48W
tagline: 2025 large-format Sculpfun: 830×800 mm bed and 48W compressed diode
tldr: The S40 MAX (2025) targets makers who outgrew 400 mm frames: 830×800 mm work area, 48W optical power, auto-focus, and Wi-Fi via TS1 screen. Built for sign panels and batch cutting: verify shipping weight and workshop space before ordering.
mainObjective: Extra-large Sculpfun diode for big panels and production-style cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Strongest cut headroom in the line: about 20 mm basswood-class stock in benchmarks
48W: the most cut-focused head in the Sculpfun S40 MAX line
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers Sculpfun S40 MAX 48W. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Use Z-axis offset per pass in LightBurn for flatter thick cuts. Budget 50L+ air assist for claimed one-pass thick cuts.
primaryUse: 2025 large-area Sculpfun for engraving and cutting oversized wood, leather, and acrylic panels.

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S40 MAX 48W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.
